questions.question: If A is the brother of B, B is the sister of C, and C is the mother of D, how is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A is the brother of B, and B is the sister of C. This makes A the brother of C. Since C is the mother of D, A is the maternal uncle of D.
stepByStep: Step 1: Identify the gender and relationship of A with respect to B. A is the brother of B.
Step 2: Identify the relationship of B with respect to C. B is the sister of C, which makes A the brother of C.
Step 3: Identify the relationship of C with respect to D. C is the mother of D.
Step 4: Combine the relationships. Since A is the brother of C and C is the mother of D, A is the maternal uncle of D.

questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, "She is the daughter of the only son of my father". How is the person in the photograph related to the man?
questions.explanation: The only son of the man's father is the man himself. Therefore, the person in the photograph is the daughter of the man. Hence, she is his sister.
stepByStep: Step 1: Identify the "only son of my father". This refers to the man himself.
Step 2: The photograph shows the daughter of this person (the man).
Step 3: Therefore, the person in the photograph is the daughter of the man.
Step 4: A daughter of the man is his sister.

questions.question: If P is the brother of Q, Q is the sister of R, and R is the mother of S, how is P related to S?
questions.explanation: P is the brother of Q, and Q is the sister of R. This makes R the sibling of P. Since R is the mother of S, P is the maternal uncle of S.
stepByStep: Step 1: Identify the sibling chain. P is the brother of Q, and Q is the sister of R. Therefore, P and R are siblings.
Step 2: R is the mother of S. Since P is the sibling of R, P is the maternal uncle (or aunt) of R's child, S.
Step 3: Hence, P is the uncle of S.

questions.question: If X is the brother of Y, Y is the sister of Z, and Z is the mother of W, how is X related to W?
questions.explanation: X is the maternal uncle of W.
stepByStep: Step 1: Identify the family structure. X is the brother of Y, meaning X and Y are siblings.
Step 2: Y is the sister of Z, confirming Y and Z are also siblings. Thus, X, Y, and Z are brothers and sisters.
Step 3: Z is the mother of W, making Z the parent and W the child.
Step 4: Since X is the brother of Z (Z's sibling), X is the uncle of Z's child, W.
